dal.name: Dalhousie University
dal.how: One online General Entrance Award application (opens Oct 1, 2026) puts you in the running for most entrance awards. International students are eligible. Usual minimum: an 80% admission average.
dal.no: Harrison McCain and Schulich Leader scholarships are for students from Canadian high schools.

smu.name: Saint Mary's University
smu.how: Your admission application is automatically assessed for Admissions Scholarships (merit-based). For extra General Entrance Awards, fill in the separate application (opens Oct 15, 2026).
smu.no: The $50,000 Presidential and Sobey National Innovator scholarships are for Canadian citizens and permanent residents only.

acadia.name: Acadia University
acadia.how: Apply for admission by March 1 and you're automatically considered. Any offer appears in your offer letter. Students with a 95% scholarship average are considered for the top awards.
acadia.no: Spicer-Hennessey, Harrison McCain and some local awards are for Nova Scotia or Canadian high school graduates.

stfx.name: St. Francis Xavier University (StFX)
stfx.how: StFX says every new student with an 85% admission average or higher is guaranteed an entrance scholarship of at least $5,000. The new McKenna Scholars program has its own application (opens Dec 1, 2026).
stfx.no: The McKenna page doesn't say whether international students qualify. Ask scholarships@stfx.ca before you apply.

cbu.name: Cape Breton University
cbu.how: Students coming straight from high school are considered for major scholarships based on their grades (CBU works out international averages itself). For other entrance scholarships, accepted students apply by March 1.
cbu.no: If you got an English-conditional offer, you must study at a CBU English partner school for the award to count.

msvu.name: Mount Saint Vincent University
msvu.how: Send a complete admission application by March 1, with at least three final-year marks, to be automatically considered. Applicants with an 80%+ average are also considered for Diamond Jubilee scholarships. MSVU says international students can get most of its funding.
msvu.no: Harrison McCain and the TD award need a Canadian high school or Canadian resident tuition. Check others with scholarships@msvu.ca.

kings.name: University of King's College
kings.how: Apply for admission by March 1 straight from high school (BA, BSc, BMus or Journalism Honours) and you're automatically considered. No scholarship form is needed except for a few named awards.
kings.no: Sobey and Weston scholarships are for Canadian citizens; Harrison McCain is for Canadian high school graduates.

nscad.name: NSCAD University
nscad.how: Apply for admission by March 1 and you're automatically considered for entrance scholarships and bursaries. Art, design and craft programs.

dal-m.name: Dalhousie University
dal-m.how: Dalhousie has $20,000 master's scholarships open to international students in thesis-based programs. Apply on the Faculty of Graduate Studies scholarship platform. A second round opens Jan 5, 2027 and closes Feb 28, 2027.
dal-m.no: The Canada Graduate Research Scholarship – Master's ($27,000) is only for Canadian citizens and permanent residents.

smu-m.name: Saint Mary's University
smu-m.how: SMU's main internal award for new research students is the Durland Graduate Research Scholarship, for incoming students in research-based master's and PhD programs. Most other funding comes from your supervisor's research grants.
smu-m.no: CGRS Master's and Mackenzie King scholarships need Canadian citizenship, permanent residence or a Canadian degree.

msvu-m.name: Mount Saint Vincent University
msvu-m.how: MSVU has one award just for international master's students, plus entrance scholarships for the thesis-based students with the highest grades. Most are decided by a committee with no application.

stfx-m.name: St. Francis Xavier University (StFX)
stfx-m.how: At StFX, funding for a thesis master's is a mix of scholarships, a teaching assistantship and your supervisor's research grant, and you name your supervisor in your application. For example, StFX Biology puts living costs at $16,000 a year. If a student has no outside scholarship, the supervisor must pay a stipend of at least $5,000 a year.
stfx-m.no: International students pay an international fee on top of regular tuition. Agree the full funding plan with your supervisor before you apply.

acadia-m.name: Acadia University
acadia-m.how: Acadia offers Acadia Graduate Scholarships and Graduate Teaching Assistantships through each department. Acadia says funding is limited and not guaranteed. You need a GPA of 3.0/4.0 in each of your last two years.

dal-p.name: Dalhousie University
dal-p.how: Dalhousie offers most of Nova Scotia's PhD programs and has large PhD scholarships open to international students. Round 1 closed Oct 16, 2026; round 2 opens Dec 1, 2026 and closes Jan 31, 2027. Apply on the Faculty of Graduate Studies scholarship platform.

cgrs.name: Canada Graduate Research Scholarship – Doctoral
cgrs.how: Canada's national PhD scholarship (it replaced the old CGS-D and Vanier). Up to 15% of awards go to international students, but you must already be registered in your PhD at a Canadian university by the deadline, so apply in your first or second year.
cgrs.no: Not for students who haven't started their PhD yet. Plan for it in year one.

smu-p.name: Saint Mary's University
smu-p.how: SMU has PhD programs in areas such as astronomy, applied science, business and international development. New PhD students can apply for the Durland Graduate Research Scholarship. The rest usually comes from your supervisor.
